knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Crew stay clear of the vehicle's path and wait until it has finished manoeuvring.
Equipment is never left unattended in a shared route, even for a short time, because it is a hazard to others.
Where the light is unsafe, the area is reported and work does not start until the lighting is adequate.
The lighting and timing section says the register asks for daytime work where it is practical, and for sufficient light levels where work is done.

practicalCriteria: Keeps to an approved pedestrian route in a simulated car park
Sets a barrier and signage around a simulated work area, and keeps equipment inside the zone
Checks and reports a simulated dark route, and does not start work there
Waits clear of a simulated reversing vehicle
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: The learner crosses a vehicle lane or stands in a reversing vehicle's path
Equipment is left unattended on a shared route
Work starts in an area that is unsafely lit
